cohort: 7 pregnancies in 6 women with pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), aged 21 to 37 years, treated at a nationally accredited pulmonary hypertension (PH) center from 2013 to 2021
finding: Multidisciplinary management of PAH in pregnancy, with an emphasis on optimizing right heart function before delivery, can lead to excellent clinical outcomes for both mother and child in a specialized PH center.
mod_finding: Five out of seven deliveries were via cesarean section, all patients received regional anesthesia, and all deliveries were without complications.
